SHIPSTATS.RollEffectsReminder: {name} took {amount} damage in one salvo: roll on the Effects Table.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Evasion: Evasion dice are independent from the Energy pool. Each success cancels one incoming hit.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Armour: Armour automatically cancels a number of attacks equal to its value, decrementing that value after the attack is resolved.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Volley: The number of broadside weapons, the basic armament, your ship has available.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Prime: The ammunition or charge for your prime (heavy) weaponry: how many times it can be used in a battle.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Energy: A pool of d12s that refreshes each round; unused Energy is lost. It equals 3 × Systems and drops automatically if Systems decrease. Committed dice don't refresh until they complete their commitment.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Systems: The ship's overall worthiness. If it reaches 0, the ship can no longer function. It isn't destroyed, but needs major repairs.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Maneuverability: The distance the ship can travel during a complete movement action. All maneuvers combined must not exceed this number. For an NPC ship this is halved (rounded down), shown in parentheses.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Initiative: Each combatant rolls initiative dice at the start of each round (not an action). The lower roll acts first; ties are re-rolled between the tied parties.
SHIPSTATS.ModPlaceholder: Enter the {stat} modification's name and description.
SHIPSTATS.NoMods: Tick "Mod" on a stat to add a modification to it.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.Modifications: A static list of your ship's modifications. To edit them and apply their effect, switch to Edit mode.
SHIPSTATS.Tip.ModificationsEdit: You can only have one mod per ship stat. Tick "Mod" on a stat to add its +/- numerical effect, then describe the modification here. If a mod's effect can't be shown as a whole-number change, note it here and, if possible, change the stat itself.
SHIPSTATS.InitiativeMod: Added to the roll (Mod box and applied effects)
SHIPSTATS.Scene.Name: Tactical Graph
SHIPSTATS.Scene.Created: Created the scene "{name}". Find it in the Scenes tab.
SHIPSTATS.Scene.Failed: Ship Stats Card: the Tactical Graph scene could not be created. See the console (F12) for details.
SHIPSTATS.Settings.Theme.Name: Tactical Graph Theme
SHIPSTATS.Settings.Theme.Hint: Dark uses white lines on black; Light uses black lines on white. Changing this also updates the Tactical Graph scenes already created by this module.
SHIPSTATS.Settings.CreateScene.Name: Create Tactical Graph Scene
SHIPSTATS.Settings.CreateScene.Label: Create Scene
SHIPSTATS.Settings.CreateScene.Hint: Creates a gridless, square (2478 × 2478 px) scene with no padding, showing the 8-sector, 4-range tactical graph at its original resolution.
SHIPSTATS.Settings.CreateScene.Confirm: Create a new Tactical Graph scene with the {theme} theme? You can change the theme in the module settings at any time.
SHIPSTATS.Settings.Rules.Name: Rules of Engagement
SHIPSTATS.Settings.Rules.Label: Open Rules
SHIPSTATS.Settings.Rules.Hint: Opens the Rules of Engagement compendium as a book with a table of contents. Nothing is imported into your world.
SHIPSTATS.Rules.Title: Rules of Engagement
SHIPSTATS.Rules.Intro: A d12-based abstract ship-to-ship combat mini-game. Choose a chapter below.
SHIPSTATS.Rules.Missing: Ship Stats Card: the Rules of Engagement compendium could not be found. Make sure the module is up to date and enabled.
SHIPSTATS.AllocateHint: Allocate Energy is mandatory on your turn and doesn't count as an action. Give each position the Energy dice it will use; unused Energy is lost at the end of the round. Allocations and used actions reset when the ship's turn starts in combat.
SHIPSTATS.AllocateAll: Give this position all remaining Energy
SHIPSTATS.Settings.PromptAllocation: Prompt for Energy allocation at turn start
SHIPSTATS.Settings.PromptAllocationHint: When a ship's turn starts in combat, ask whoever plays it to hand out Energy to the crew positions (this client only).
SHIPSTATS.NoSystemsDamage: This ship has no Systems damage to repair.
SHIPSTATS.NoEnergyForRole: {role} has no Energy to use. Allocate some first.
SHIPSTATS.NoDiceAvailable: There are no Energy dice available for this action.
SHIPSTATS.DebrisCost: Debris: each die costs 2 Energy (max {max} dice)
